(A)_[made]_
(B)_[had in your possession ]_

a document which so closely resembled a

(C)_[document authorising the driving of a relevant vehicle for a specified period of up to 12 months while undertaking a vocational training course leading to a professional qualification relevant to the carriage by road of passengers or goods,]_
(D)_[driver qualification card,]_
(E)_[Community licence with the Community code,]_
(F)_[driver's certificate granted to that person by a member State other than the United Kingdom as referred to in Article 10(3)(a) of Community Directive 2003/59/EC,]_

english.notes:
(i) These regulations apply to persons driving a bus on or after 10th September 2008 or driving a lorry on or after 10th September 2009.
(ii) "Relevant vehicle" means a vehicle for which is required a driving licence of category C, C+E, D or D+E as defined in Article 3(1) of the Driving Licences Directive, or a driving licence recognised as equivalent.
(iii) "Road" means any road open to the public.
(iv) See regulation 3(2) for vehicles to which these regulations DO NOT apply.
(v) Being the holder of a certificate as required by the regulation may be evidenced by possession and production of any of the following:-
(a) a driver qualification card;
(b) a Community licence with the Community code;
(c) a driver's certificate granted to him/her by a member State other than the United Kingdom as referred to in Article 10(3)(a) of Community Directive No 2003/59/EC; or
(d) any other document issued to the driver by a member State other than the United Kingdom certifying an initial CPC or a periodic CPC .
(vi) In England, Wales and Northern Ireland, "forges" means makes a false document in order that it may be used as genuine.
(vii) See regulation 13(5), (6), (7) and (8) for details in relation to the time limits on prosecutions.
(viii) In relation to proceedings in Scotland, section 136(3) of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995 (date of commencement of proceedings) shall apply for the purposes of this regulation as it applies for the purposes of that section.
(ix) See regulation 14 for the power to seize documents.
